## Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this pull request changes, improves, or fixes.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / repo hygiene (no functional changes)
- [ ] Performance improvement

## Testing & Verification
Describe how you tested these changes:
- [ ] Backend linting passed (`ruff check .`)
- [ ] Backend smoke tests passed (`pytest -v tests/test_smoke.py`)
- [ ] Frontend linting passed (`cd frontend && npm run lint`)
- [ ] Frontend build succeeded (`cd frontend && npm run build`)
- [ ] Manual browser / API testing completed

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's code style and guidelines.
- [ ] I have not touched any production deploy triggers or CI workflows unintentionally.
- [ ] I have not committed any secrets, API keys, credentials, or `.env` files.
- [ ] I have updated documentation or `.env.example` where applicable.
